references.text: Previous verse that also deals with the right shoulder as a gift to the priest from peace offerings
The continuation explaining that the breast and the shoulder are given to Aaron and his sons as an everlasting right
Describes the fat that is to be offered from the peace offerings, mentioned in this verse
Aaron waves the breast and the right shoulder as a wave offering, in accordance with the instructions given here
Repeats that the breast and the shoulder belong to the priests as their portion of the sacrifice
Early instruction that the breast and the shoulder from the ordination offering belong to Aaron and his sons
Confirms that the meat from the wave offerings belongs to the priests, including the right shoulder
Repeats the priests' right to the shoulder and other parts of the sacrificial animals
